cards.name: Bleeding
Bufotoxin
cards.text:
Flip this card face-down when you receive it. The Adversary may flip it face-up on any of their turns, applying the following text:
Next round, you can only use the center line of your Flashlight for line of sight. Discard this Condition at the end of the next round

cards.name: Choking Fear
cards.text:
On your next turn, you may not Sprint and your {footprint} is reduced by 1
Discard this Condition at the end of your next turn

cards.name: Darkness
cards.text:
On your next turn, you may not use your Flashlight
Discard this Condition at the end of your next turn
If you already have Darkness and a card instructs you to gain it, lose 1 {charge} instead

cards.name: Gear Jam
cards.text:
You may not take the Charge Final Action unless you spend a {lungs}
At the end of each of your turns, roll a D6. On a 4+, discard this Condition

cards.name: Mauled
cards.text: Each time you gain 1 or more {blood} from the Adversary, gain 1 additional {faceDownWound}

cards.name: Neurotoxin
cards.text:
At the start of each of your turns, place a {faceUpWound} below this card. You suffer the effects of the {faceUpWound}, but it does not take up a Wound slot
If there are 2 {faceUpWound} below this card at the end of the round, discard this Condition and both {faceUpWound}

cards.name: Paranoid
cards.text:
Roll a D6 at the beginning of each of your turns:
1–2: Halve your {footprint} (including Sprint) this round
3–4: No effect
5–6: Discard this Condition

cards.name: Possessed
cards.text:
At the start of any Adversary turn, the Adversary may move you up to 4 spaces and take the Bloodletting Action with you, discarding this Condition afterwards
After this card is used, you cannot gain {blood} and you cannot be the target of Bloodletting or Severed Ear for the rest of the Adversary's turn
cards.notes: Cult-specific: references Bloodletting (Cultist action) and Severed Ear (a Mor'gonnod ability; his abilities are named after body parts). Only 1 copy in the deck.
